## Idea

The {{#concept "subtractive ideal generated by a subset" Disambiguation="semirings" Agda=subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring}} `S` of
a [semiring](ring-theory.semirings.md) `R` is the least [subtractive ideal](ring-theory.subtractive-ideals-semirings.md) in `R` containing
the [subset](ring-theory.subsets-semirings.md) `S`. More explicitly, it is the [subtractive closure](ring-theory.subtractive-closure-ideals-semirings.md) of the [ideal generated by the subset](ring-theory.ideals-generated-by-subsets-semirings.lagda.md) `S`.

## Definitions

### The universal property of subtractive ideals generated by a subset of a semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (S : subset-Semiring l2 R)
  (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring : UUω
  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring =
    {l : Level} (J : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l R) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I J ↔
    (S ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J)

  contains-subset-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring :
    is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring →
    S ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I
  contains-subset-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring U =
    forward-implication (U I) (refl-leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I)

  leq-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring :
    is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring →
    {l4 : Level} (J : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l4 R) →
    S ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I J
  leq-is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring U J =
    backward-implication (U J)
```

### The universal property of subtractive ideals generated by a family of subsets of a semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 l4 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {U : UU l2}
  (S : U → subset-Semiring l3 R)
  (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l4 R)
  (H : (α : U) → S α ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I)
  where

  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-Semiring : UUω
  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-Semiring =
    {l : Level} (J : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l R) →
    ((α : U) → S α ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I J
```

### Construction of the Galois connection of subtractive ideals generated by subsets

#### Subtractrive ideals generated by subsets

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (S : subset-Semiring l2 R)
  where

  subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring : subset-Semiring (l1 ⊔ l2) R
  subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    subset-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring : type-Semiring R → UU (l1 ⊔ l2)
  is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-in-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-prop-is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    (r : type-Semiring R) → is-prop (is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring r)
  is-prop-is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-prop-is-in-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  type-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring : UU (l1 ⊔ l2)
  type-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    type-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    type-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring → type-Semiring R
  inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    inclusion-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  ap-inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    (x y : type-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring) → x ＝ y →
    inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring x ＝
    inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring y
  ap-inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    ap-inclusion-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-in-subset-inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    (y : type-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring) →
    is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
      ( inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring y)
  is-in-subset-inclusion-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-in-subset-inclusion-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  contains-zero-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    contains-zero-subset-Semiring R subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
  contains-zero-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    contains-zero-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-closed-under-addition-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-addition-subset-Semiring R
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring)
  is-closed-under-addition-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-addition-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-subset-Semiring R
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring)
  is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring
      ( R)
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-left-multiplication-subset-Semiring R
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring)
  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-left-multiplication-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-closed-under-right-multiplication-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-closed-under-right-multiplication-subset-Semiring R
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring)
  is-closed-under-right-multiplication-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-right-multiplication-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    subtractive-ideal-Semiring (l1 ⊔ l2) R
  subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-ideal-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-ideal-subset-Semiring R subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
  is-ideal-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-ideal-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  ideal-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    ideal-Semiring (l1 ⊔ l2) R
  ideal-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    ideal-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  is-subtractive-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R ideal-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
  is-subtractive-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-subtractive-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)
    
  is-additive-submonoid-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-additive-submonoid-subset-Semiring R
      subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
  is-additive-submonoid-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-additive-submonoid-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  additive-submonoid-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    Submonoid (l1 ⊔ l2) (additive-monoid-Semiring R)
  additive-submonoid-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    additive-submonoid-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    S ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
  contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    transitive-leq-subtype
      ( S)
      ( subset-ideal-subset-Semiring R S)
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring)
      ( contains-ideal-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
        ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S))
      ( contains-subset-ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  contains-subset-leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {l3 : Level} (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l3 R) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I →
    S ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I
  contains-subset-leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I H =
    transitive-leq-subtype
      ( S)
      ( subset-ideal-subset-Semiring R S)
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I)
      ( contains-ideal-leq-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
        ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)
        ( I)
        ( H))
      ( contains-subset-ideal-subset-Semiring R S)

  leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {l3 : Level} (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l3 R) →
    S ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I
  leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I H =
    leq-subtractive-closure-ideal-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Semiring R S)
      ( I)
      ( leq-ideal-subset-Semiring R S
        ( ideal-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I)
        ( H))

  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring R S
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring)
  pr1
    ( is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I) =
    contains-subset-leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I
  pr2
    ( is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I) =
    leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I

  is-closed-under-eq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {x y : type-Semiring R} → is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring x →
    (x ＝ y) → is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring y
  is-closed-under-eq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    is-closed-under-eq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R
      subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring

  is-closed-under-eq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring' :
    {x y : type-Semiring R} → is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring y →
    (x ＝ y) → is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring x
  is-closed-under-eq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring' =
    is-closed-under-eq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring' R
      subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
```

#### The subset relation is preserved by generating subtractive ideals

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (A : Semiring l1)
  where

  preserves-order-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {l2 l3 : Level} (S : subset-Semiring l2 A) (T : subset-Semiring l3 A) →
    S ⊆ T →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A S)
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A T)
  preserves-order-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring S T H =
    leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A S
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A T)
      ( transitive-leq-subtype S T
        ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A T)
        ( contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A T)
        ( H))

  subtractive-ideal-subset-hom-large-poset-Semiring :
    hom-Large-Poset
      ( λ l2 → l1 ⊔ l2)
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Semiring A))
      ( subtractive-ideal-Semiring-Large-Poset A)
  map-hom-Large-Preorder
    subtractive-ideal-subset-hom-large-poset-Semiring =
    subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A
  preserves-order-hom-Large-Preorder
    subtractive-ideal-subset-hom-large-poset-Semiring =
    preserves-order-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
```

#### The Galois connection `S ↦ (S)`

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (A : Semiring l1)
  where

  adjoint-relation-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {l2 l3 : Level} (S : subset-Semiring l2 A) (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l3 A) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A (subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A S) I ↔
    (S ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I)
  pr1 (adjoint-relation-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring S I) H =
    transitive-leq-subtype S
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A S)
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I)
      ( H)
      ( contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A S)
  pr2 (adjoint-relation-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring S I) =
    leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A S I

  subtractive-ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring :
    galois-connection-Large-Poset
      ( l1 ⊔_) (λ l → l)
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Semiring A))
      ( subtractive-ideal-Semiring-Large-Poset A)
  lower-adjoint-galois-connection-Large-Poset
    subtractive-ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring =
    subtractive-ideal-subset-hom-large-poset-Semiring A
  upper-adjoint-galois-connection-Large-Poset
    subtractive-ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring =
    subset-subtractive-ideal-hom-large-poset-Semiring A
  adjoint-relation-galois-connection-Large-Poset
    subtractive-ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring =
    adjoint-relation-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
```

#### The reflective Galois connection `S ↦ (S)`

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (A : Semiring l1)
  where

  forward-inclusion-is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {l2 : Level} (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l2 A) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A
        ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I))
      ( I)
  forward-inclusion-is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
    I =
    leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I)
      ( I)
      ( refl-leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I)

  backward-inclusion-is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {l2 : Level} (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l2 A) →
    leq-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A
        ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I))
  backward-inclusion-is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
    I =
    contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring A
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring A I)

  is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    is-reflective-galois-connection-Large-Poset
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Semiring A))
      ( subtractive-ideal-Semiring-Large-Poset A)
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring A)
  pr1 (is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I) =
    forward-inclusion-is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
      I
  pr2 (is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring I) =
    backward-inclusion-is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
      I

  subtractive-ideal-subset-reflective-galois-connection-Semiring :
    reflective-galois-connection-Large-Poset
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Semiring A))
      ( subtractive-ideal-Semiring-Large-Poset A)
  galois-connection-reflective-galois-connection-Large-Poset
    subtractive-ideal-subset-reflective-galois-connection-Semiring =
    subtractive-ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring A
  is-reflective-reflective-galois-connection-Large-Poset
    subtractive-ideal-subset-reflective-galois-connection-Semiring =
    is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring
```

### The ideal generated by a family of subsets of a semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) {U : UU l2} (S : U → subset-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  generating-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring :
    subset-Semiring (l2 ⊔ l3) R
  generating-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring x =
    union-family-of-subtypes S x

  subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring :
    subtractive-ideal-Semiring (l1 ⊔ l2 ⊔ l3) R
  subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring =
    subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      generating-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring

  subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring :
    subset-Semiring (l1 ⊔ l2 ⊔ l3) R
  subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring =
    subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      generating-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring

  is-in-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring :
    type-Semiring R → UU (l1 ⊔ l2 ⊔ l3)
  is-in-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring =
    is-in-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      generating-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring

  contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring :
    {α : U} → (S α) ⊆ subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
  contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring {α} x H =
    contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      ( generating-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring)
      ( x)
      ( unit-trunc-Prop (α , H))

  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring :
    is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-Semiring R S
      ( subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring)
      ( λ α → contains-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring)
  is-subtractive-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
    J H =
    leq-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
      ( generating-subset-subtractive-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring)
      ( J)
      ( λ y q →
        apply-universal-property-trunc-Prop q
          ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R J y)
          ( λ (α , K) → H α y K))
```

## Properties

### The ideal generated by the underlying subset of an ideal `I` is `I` itself

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Semiring l1) (I : subtractive-ideal-Semiring l2 R)
  where

  idempotent-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
        ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I))
      ( I)
  idempotent-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    has-same-elements-sim-subtype
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R
        ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I))
      ( subset-subtractive-ideal-Semiring R I)
      ( is-reflective-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R I)
```

### The operation `S ↦ (S)` preserves least upper bounds

In
[`ring-theory.joins-ideals-semirings`](ring-theory.joins-ideals-semirings.md)
we will convert this fact to the fact that `S ↦ (S)` preserves joins.

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Semiring l1)
  {U : UU l2} (S : U → subset-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  preserves-least-upper-bounds-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring :
    {l4 : Level} (T : subset-Semiring l4 R) →
    is-least-upper-bound-family-of-elements-Large-Poset
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Semiring R))
      ( S)
      ( T) →
    is-least-upper-bound-family-of-elements-Large-Poset
      ( subtractive-ideal-Semiring-Large-Poset R)
      ( λ α → subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R (S α))
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring R T)
  preserves-least-upper-bounds-subtractive-ideal-subset-Semiring =
    preserves-join-lower-adjoint-galois-connection-Large-Poset
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Semiring R))
      ( subtractive-ideal-Semiring-Large-Poset R)
      ( subtractive-ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring R)
      ( S)
```
